heroHeadline: Christ Hospital Ohio Launches CRISPR Trial for High Cholesterol, Expanding Beyond Genetic Disease
heroSubtitle: October 14, 2026: Christ Hospital in Cincinnati, Ohio has initiated a CRISPR gene-editing clinical trial targeting high cholesterol patients, broadening CRISPR therapy into common cardiometabolic conditions. This follows the October 1 BLA approval of an in vivo CRISPR treatment for hereditary angioedema.
footerNote: Data sourced from FDA, EMA, MHRA, NIH, peer-reviewed journals (Nature, Science, NEJM, Cell), ClinicalTrials.gov, and major science outlets. Clinical data reflects published peer-reviewed results only.
